build_OutputProjection: build an OutputProjection module to project node, edge, and global readout features using configurable linear layers and normalization
build_OutputLayer: build an OutputLayer module to produce final vector or scalar predictions from backbone features via an MLP head
test_OutputProjection_forward: test the OutputProjection forward pass with node, edge, and global readout tensors to verify projected feature outputs
test_OutputLayer_forward: test the OutputLayer forward pass with backbone feature tensors to verify vector or scalar prediction output
review_OutputLayer_output_type: review the OutputLayer class and its Vector versus Scalar output type configuration for force or energy prediction
